symptom: The new learning record used a Git compare-style evidence reference containing two adjacent dots; governance rejected the entire registry check even though no private path was present.
lesson: Evidence refs in LEARN records are metadata identifiers, not Git compare expressions; the canonical sanitizer rejects any double-dot substring as a traversal marker, including Git compare notation.
guardrail: Before creating a LEARN record, reject any evidenceRef containing adjacent dots, absolute prefixes, backslashes or private path markers; represent a commit comparison as two separate commit refs or a hyphenated metadata label; recompute canonical-v2 digest after correction and require research-governance CI.
